Based on my search of Wonder's internal documentation, here's what **Arcadia** is in the Wonder business context:

## What is Arcadia?

**Arcadia is a third-party frozen cold-storage facility (3PL) operated by RMX Global Logistics**, located at 300 Parkview Rd, Hazle Township, PA 18202. It serves as a **frozen buffer and overflow node that replenishes DISH** — Wonder's main distribution hub.

### Core Function

Arcadia receives frozen inventory from vendors and co-manufacturers, then runs daily/weekly replenishment transfers to DISH to:
- Keep DISH stocked with frozen products
- Relieve DISH's freezer capacity constraints
- Support Wonder's frozen product supply chain (including 3P vendor goods, co-packs, HDR crusts, and B2B inventory)

### Technical Details

- **WMS**: Blue Yonder (their internal portal called "ArcadiaOne") — not ShipHero
- **System of Record**: RMX daily inventory snapshots (email/CSV exports) since Jan 2026, after ShipHero proved unreliable for Arcadia inventory
- **Integration**: Modeled as a separate warehouse in ShipHero; Purchase Orders created in ShipHero, transfers handled via manual/semi-automated workflows
- **Receiving Cadence**: Monday–Friday only; transfers occur Tue→Thu and Fri→Mon

### Current Status (July 2026)

Arcadia is currently an **active operational node**, though facing potential transition. According to documentation, there's an ongoing decision (due July 13, 2026) between replacing it with either **Lineage** (a 3PL on Accellos One with EDI integration) or **Linden** (a Wonder-operated facility on existing ShipHero infrastructure).

## Key Sources

- [Arcadia Go Live](https://wonder.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SC/pages/4304109749) — Comprehensive operational setup (Supply Chain space)
- [Arcadia PO/Transfers in ShipHero — Current State, History](https://wonder.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SC/pages/5461311686) — Detailed architecture and evolution (Supply Chain space)
- [WORK-1281: Add RMX Arcadia as a new facility](https://wonder.atlassian.net/browse/WORK-1281) — Initial facility setup in WOMS
- [SUPPLY-1851: Onboarding Arcadia Orders to POMS](https://wonder.atlassian.net/browse/SUPPLY-1851) — Epic covering order management integration

The documentation reflects recent supply chain consolidation efforts and ongoing system modernization to ensure reliable, auditable frozen inventory flows across Wonder's facilities.
